pageText: THE FUSION OF TENNIS & SQUASH IS PADEL Join us in this dynamic and socially engaging sport that combines elements of tennis and squash. Our Padel courts are now open and ready to serve you ! Enroll Now IN PADEL, SUCCESS IS A COMBINATION OF SKILL, TEAMWORK, AND STRATEGIC THINKING. OUR PADEL ACADEMY Welcome to ASA Padel Academy At ASA Padel Academy, one of Beirut's largest padel arenas, we're dedicated to helping you master padel technique. Our top-notch facilities and expert coaches create an ideal setting for players of all levels to enhance their skills. We offer tailored programs for everyone, from beginners to advanced players, focusing on technique and strategy. Our experienced coaches provide personalized instruction to help you reach your full potential. Join us at ASA Padel Academy to refine your padel game in a vibrant community. It's the perfect place for you to learn, improve, and enjoy the sport. Our Padel Academy's objective is to prepare kids from a young age for the professionalism of the game. Beyond the social aspects and fun that the game offers, we focus on developing their fitness and logical skills. At ASA, we teach the kids the basics of the game and closely monitor their progress to introduce them to advanced techniques and new skills. We are Mainly located in Tallet el Khayat and we will be soon opening in a new location. Our padel academy can accommodate between 50 to 80 kids per hour. We have 5 padel coaches, each responsible for their own court. classes are divided between age and level. JOIN US AND ELEVATE YOUR GAME TO THE NEXT LEVEL Gallery 12345678910 JOIN THE COMMUNITY
